8188.title: Failed availability refresh is cached as an unavailable parent
8188.rootCauseOneLine: A failed availability refresh becomes UNAVAILABLE_POOL and is cached for the full successful-response TTL of 30 seconds.

prReviews.verdict: Static-only review: plausible root-cause repair; runtime not verified
prReviews.topFinding: The diff retains prior positive availability for all errors; authorization rejection and invalid-payload transition coverage should be checked.

8188.proposedFix: Separate failed refreshes from authoritative negative answers; use bounded last-success retention and a shorter error retry interval.
8188.caveats: Availability/cache behavior reproduced twice with real HTTP; expiry clock advanced through existing injection. No live Claude login or provider-retry turn was executed. Duplicate fix skipped because PR #8187 is open.
